title: Tests never drive the HTTP handler; the repaired GET /books/{id} route is unverified
evidence: test_api.c:60-66 calls only test_json_escaping/test_request_fields/test_sqlite_crud_and_author_filter/test_book_json_by_id — all hit static helpers (jsonstr, field, execute_book, books_json). The handler() router (book_service.c:27-40) is never invoked, so the FEEDBACK.md bug (GET /books/{id} returned 404) is fixed by code inspection only, with no regression test.
suggestion: Add a test that calls handler() for GET /books/{id} (or an end-to-end request against the daemon) to lock in the fix.

title: PUT /books/{id} leaks the merged field strings on the success path
evidence: book_service.c:36 — after execute_book('UPDATE ...',ot,oa,oy,oi,id) the ot/oa/oy/oi buffers (and the original t/a/y/i they may alias) are never freed before respond(); only the 400/404 branches free some of them.
suggestion: free(ot);free(oa);free(oy);free(oi); after the UPDATE on every exit path.
